SELECT audit_events.id, audit_events.kind, audit_events.at, audit_events.details 
FROM audit_events 
WHERE audit_events.kind = $1::VARCHAR AND CAST((audit_events.details ->> $2::TEXT) AS VARCHAR) = $3::VARCHAR AND (CAST(CAST((audit_events.details ->> $4::TEXT) AS VARCHAR) AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR CAST(CAST((audit_events.details ->> $5::TEXT) AS VARCHAR) AS BIGINT) < $6::BIGINT AND CAST(CAST((audit_events.details ->> $7::TEXT) AS VARCHAR) AS BIGINT) > $8::BIGINT)

INSERT INTO chart_published_bars (instrument_id, timeframe, start, "end", complete, payload, revision) VALUES ($1::VARCHAR, $2::VARCHAR, $3::BIGINT, $4::BIGINT, $5, $6::JSON, $7::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, timeframe, start) DO UPDATE SET "end" = excluded."end", complete = excluded.complete, payload = excluded.payload, revision = (chart_published_bars.revision + $8::INTEGER)

SELECT candles.id, candles.instrument_id, candles.timeframe, candles.start, candles."end", candles.open, candles.high, candles.low, candles.close, candles.complete, candles.revision, candles.received_at, candles.observed_at, candles.volume, candles.volume_complete, candles.volume_received_at, candles.volume_revision 
FROM candles 
WHERE candles.instrument_id = $1::VARCHAR AND candles.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR AND candles.start < $3::BIGINT ORDER BY candles.start DESC 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM chart_published_bars 
WHERE chart_published_bars.instrument_id = $1::VARCHAR AND chart_published_bars.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR AND chart_published_bars.start >= $3::BIGINT AND chart_published_bars."end" <= $4::BIGINT AND chart_published_bars.complete IS true
